invariant: ADR-0155 D2, D4: `fixedInnerReadSQL` is the remote twin of `SqlDriver#fixedReadLeafSubquery`, compiled from the same predicates (`fixedInnerReadPredicates`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`), every value bound and with no tenant scope (① ruled A); `TursoDriver` declares `fixedReadLeaves` in remote mode only because this compiles it. A resolved `ReadableIds` semi-join (ADR-0139 D3) carries the tenant wall the driver handed over; the fixed inner read carries none.
